text:
anya: Quick design sync — proposing a density toggle for the roles grid in the invite drawer (Compact / Comfortable) plus SSO annotations. Goal: let power users scan more roles while keeping mobile friendly. Figma: https://figma.redwood/roles-density :link
matt: Love the toggle. Suggest default to Comfortable on mobile and persist per-user preference. On small widths, show up to 3 chips then a '+N more' overflow that opens the full list.
rui: Accessibility notes: rows must be keyboard navigable (Arrow keys), use aria-selected for focused row and aria-controls to link to a detail panel. When preview updates, announce via aria-live=polite (e.g., "Preview: Viewer role, read only"). Truncated names need aria-label with full role + short permission summary.
sarah: Copy suggestions: chip teaser "Viewer — read only"; detail header "Viewer role" and bullets: "View projects", "View logs & audit entries", "Cannot invite". For SSO enforcement toggles draft modal: "Disabling SSO enforcement may allow users to sign in without your identity provider. To confirm, type your org name: <org-name>" Primary CTA: "Disable enforcement" Secondary: "Cancel". I'll run final wording by legal.
ken: Telemetry to add: `invite.density_change`, `rbac.role_preview_shown`, `invite.overflow_open`, `org.sso.enforcement_changed`. Also capture device breakpoint and `time_to_invite_ms` to measure impact.
anya: Decision: implement a per-user density toggle, compact grid with +N overflow on narrow viewports, lock icon + tooltip for SSO-required roles, and typed-confirm when disabling enforcement. Next steps: Rui write ARIA & keyboard spec (Thu EOD); Matt update Figma with overflow and mobile defaults (Wed); Sarah send modal copy to legal (Thu); Ken add telemetry spike and tickets.
matt: ack :thumbsup:
rui: will include SR announcement examples and DOM snippets :eyes:
sarah: pinging legal now
ken: adding tracking tickets
anya: Thanks all — we'll run a 5-user usability pass next week focused on density discoverability and SSO modal clarity. :sparkles:
